text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic. One major problem is bias: if training data is unfair, the AI may treat some groups badly. Fairness means designing systems that give everyone equal chances. Privacy matters too, because AI often collects personal information, and users must know how it is used. Transparency is also important; people should understand how an AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must think about the possible harm of new technology. They should test systems carefully and listen to different opinions before releasing them. In short, ethics should guide AI from the very beginning.
